image_description: A row of five disposable plastic lighters arranged diagonally against a white background. The lighters are translucent in red, teal/green, and blue colors. They feature standard metal wind guards and ignition mechanisms at the top. Some lighters have white text printed on their bodies.

artifact_observations.location: White text on the bodies of the green and red lighters
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text appears to be pseudo-branding. While it mimics the shape of letters, the characters are nonsensical and slightly malformed, a common AI artifact where text is simulated rather than rendered.

The refraction and internal consistency of the plastic look slightly uniform and 'waxy' rather than having the sharp specular highlights and complex internal distortions expected from real mass-produced plastic.
